<p align="center"><strong>Find the true bearing beyond the Halloween threshold.</strong></p>

<p align="center"><small><strong>Inventory:</strong> Brass key &middot; Moonseed &middot; Copper coil &middot; Star lantern &middot; Black cat companion</small></p>


<p align="center">The stepped roof opens onto a sky without a moon. Four stars form a diamond above the trees. Below, every path seems to bend back toward the house.</p>

<p align="center">The telescope has north, east and west bearings. Elias left a chart beside it. Your lantern keeps the stairs behind you lit.</p>

<p align="center">Your cat watches the stairwell. When it growls, the knocking below stops for a moment.</p>
